description: Guard (016 plan D10/D11, mutation e). A comment opens after a code span ending in a backslash and closes at the next line's digest marker, with no blank line between: a real inline comment, holding the marker. The digest on disk carries only the two markers outside the comment, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. D10 disarms an opener only when no closer follows before a blank line; without that check the marker would be harvested.
